rationale.hitl-workflow: bounded delegation—human approval gates, no auto-merge/commit across all 22 systems
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: right-shift problem: generation outpaces verification, reviewers face more code
rationale.oversight-explanation: uncertainty signaling, explainable risk scores, surface what was checked
rationale.provenance-auditability: provenance guardrail; auditable trails so humans can verify AI outputs
rationale.ai-review: wanted AI PR-review/quality-gate systems; reliability limits (confident-wrong)
rationale.rules-based-checks: quality gates combine deterministic static/taint checks with model reasoning
rationale.risk-routing: change risk radar scores changes; security-critical fixes tiered to human
rationale.regulatory-compliance: compliance evidence compiler: policy applicability, audit-ready evidence
rationale.counterpoint: opposes automation-maximalism; augmentation over automation, craft never delegated
